name: Signed By Identity
description: The Fulcio cert for this Rekor entry asserts this identity as the signer. The target side is unconstrained (wildcard): the signer identity may be any identity node type (a CI workflow, a raw email identity, a GitLab workflow, etc.) — the edge deliberately does not bind to a single platform's node type. Caller-supplied: the decompose helper emits this edge only when the caller passes a resolved identity entity id, performing no cross-plugin graph reads of its own.
